invariants.rule: Modify only CellShard; never modify CellStack, Cellerator, or Baseplane, and do not depend on their uncommitted state.
CellShard preserves execution-image bytes and identities without decoding, canonicalization, sparse conversion, CP-BP interpretation, or kernel policy.
CSPACK01 and CPEXEC01 remain supported byte-compatible legacy paths; CPEXEC02 is separate and never changes the top-level CSPACK01 header.
Service and placement epochs never participate in immutable image identity; missing legacy identities require explicit adapter context and are never invented by hashing.

The CS-FOUND foundational loading, staging, and binding path uses non-owning views and move-only leases; source to host uses one payload allocation and host to device uses one caller-allocator allocation plus one cudaMemcpyAsync. This does not prescribe the copy or allocation count of a later streaming engine.
Do not add networking, collectives, a scheduler, a database, topology or biological placement, a general cache, an async I/O framework, or a new public archive or manifest format.

Non-goals: every later placement, routing, networking, scheduling, collective, streaming, and cache program. Dependencies: none. Interfaces consumed: current CellShard legacy contracts. Interfaces produced: CS-FOUND-I1 through I5B. Likely files: program-wide CellShard files only. Locks: all declared locks are delegated to child tasks. Acceptance: all children complete, opaque local vertical slice passes, CPEXEC01 remains supported, CPEXEC02 exists, docs are honest. Validation: CS-FOUND-15 gates and todo audit. Failure: any external-repo modification or scope expansion. Compatibility: preserve current public APIs and CSPACK01. Migration follow-up: recommend but do not create a broader physical-runtime investigation covering streaming, working sets, representation, residency, topology, and placement. Evidence: commits, gates, checkpoints, audit. Rollback: child changes remain independently revertible; no public format is mutated in place.
